notes: Renderer no longer depends on src/MusicList.json — the 'random background music' pool is now defined inline in src/Main.tsx (the 7 tracks in public/music/). One less stray file, and the render builds without it. Note: random mode now picks from all those tracks (the old list effectively only had island-by-mbb.mp3); edit defaultMusicList in Main.tsx to change the pool. Picking a specific track in the editor is unaffected.
